Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 6), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the Wikipedia information. The Wikipedia page clearly states that the conference was known as the "North Atlantic Conference" from 1988 to 1996. However, the Planner erroneously concluded that the former name was "ECAC North," confusing the name used from 1979 to 1988 with the name used during the specific period in question (1988–1996). This led to the wrong final answer ("ECAC North") instead of the correct answer ("North Atlantic Conference").
